text: L5: raise the move budget by 2 → no-ability win goes 50% → about 75%
why: L5 no-ability is 50%, too hard for its band (75-100%). The move budget is the cleanest knob.

text: L6: remove the bishop on b5 → freeze-ray win goes 75% → about 85%
why: freeze-ray is the weakest finisher anywhere (75% on L6, below the 80% floor). The bishop on b5 is the hunter closest to the king.

text: L9: raise the move budget by 2 → no-ability win goes 0% → about 4%
why: L9 is the hardest level (0% no-ability); +2 moves shows how far the budget knob moves it.

text: L6: lower the move budget by 2 → no-ability win goes 100% → about 96%
why: L6 no-ability is 100%, too easy for its band (35-65%). The move budget is the cleanest knob.

text: L10: remove the knight on h5 → freeze-ray win goes 33% → about 43%
why: freeze-ray is the weakest finisher anywhere (33% on L10, below the 80% floor). The knight on h5 is the hunter closest to the king.
